verdict.rationale: LibreChat has a first-party "Scheduled Chats" feature page, which points to its own capability for running agent/chat tasks on a schedule rather than only interactively. The evidence is just the page title, with no detail on triggers, autonomous execution, or background behaviour. missing for 10: documented details of scheduling and trigger options, confirmation that runs execute unattended in the background with agents and tools, notification or result-delivery behaviour, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
